entries.name: Spring
entries.desc: Orchids open on the high ledges; the Sky Ledges' hundred-year orchid flowers.

entries.name: Summer
entries.desc: The river runs warm. Hundred-year ember peppers redden and the thousand-year root wakes.

entries.name: Autumn
entries.desc: Mist settles on the slopes and the old soulbells ring.

entries.name: Winter
entries.desc: Most rare herbs sleep. The ones without a season keep their own time.
